query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  DATE_FORMAT(s.saleDate, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i') as data,
  s.finalAmount,
  s.saleType,
  s.notes,
  r.totalAmount as recebivel
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN receivables r ON r.saleId = s.id
WHERE s.customerId = 270001
ORDER BY s.saleDate;
